g.text: One chip generation dominates the supply chain

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: every chip type in the source, ranked by the component cost it consumed over the whole window. Epoch's

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: published figure never goes below the designer; the chip-level file does, and it is where the concentration actually

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Components (CC-BY) — cumulative_by_chip.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-components

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI Chip Components methodology; every figure is a Monte Carlo median over 10,000 draws

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Each bar is that chip's final published cumulative row - a chip's cumulative series ends in its last active quarter, so the last row

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: is its lifetime total, and nothing is summed across quarters here. 16 chip types across 4 designers, cumulative through Q4 2025. B300

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: alone accounts for 30% of tracked component spend, and NVIDIA's four chip types account for 73%. Chips retired inside the window

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: (H20, MI300A, Trainium1, TPU v5e/v5p) stop accumulating where the source stops recording them, which is why their totals are small

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: rather than absent. Component cost is not price or revenue.
